name: Relocadi
conflict_findings: DNS clean on all TLDs but phonetically/visually close to Relocity (major VC-backed relocation SaaS, relocity.com, Fortune-500 clients) and Relocify (NL relocation startup). 'reloc-' root is crowded in relocation.
thai_pronunciation_note: re-lo-KAA-di; Thai easy (r/l fluid), but resembles existing reloc- brands

name: Dwello
conflict_findings: .com and .io registered (dwello resembles multiple proptech/fintech 'dwelo/dwello' brands); relocation-adjacent property connotation.
thai_pronunciation_note: dweh-LOH; Thai ok; 'dw' cluster slightly harder

name: Arrivo
conflict_findings: .com/.io registered; 'arrivo' = Italian for 'arrival' and used by travel/transport brands; near-generic arrival word.

name: Lumio
conflict_findings: .com registered; many existing 'Lumio' products (lighting/tech/games); weak relocation link.

name: Kova
conflict_findings: .com/.io registered; several Kova brands; no relocation meaning.

name: Rova
conflict_findings: .com/.io registered; used by travel/other brands; no clear meaning.

name: Tula
conflict_findings: .com/.io registered; 'Tula' is an established baby-carrier brand and a common word/name; weak and crowded.

name: LocalFooting
conflict_findings: No in-sector company found in exact-match search; all .com/.io/.app/.co/.co.uk return no NS; YouTube @localfooting 404. 'Get a footing' = establish yourself; local + secure.
thai_pronunciation_note: LOH-kǝl FUu-ting; Thai easy (f+t+ng all fine; -ing renders -ิง/-ing)

name: CityOrienteer
conflict_findings: All checked TLDs no-NS; YouTube 404. 'Orienteer' alone is used by a US music-PR firm (orienteer.us) and an outdoor navigation app (Barleycorn; orienteer.co) - different sectors, but navigation/app meaning overlaps slightly; professional check needed. Strong ownable metaphor (navigate your new city).
thai_pronunciation_note: si-tee aw-ri-uhn-TIA; Thai: 'orienteer' 3 syllables, -r/-eer render as -ia/-aa; acceptable but longer

name: NewHereCo
conflict_findings: TLDs no-NS, but YouTube @newhereco resolves to an existing channel ('I'm New Here'); 'new here' is a common phrase with many apps/posts, weaker as a mark; the 'Co' suffix helps. Very clear meaning.

name: FreshWeeks
conflict_findings: Most TLDs no-NS (.app probe errored - recheck); no in-sector brand found. Evokes the first weeks, but reads slightly product/programme-like and is less natural as a company name.

name: LocalOrbit
conflict_findings: .com probe returned ambiguous (rate-limit); 'orbit' is a common startup metaphor with several LocalOrbit/orbit-local style names; recheck before shortlisting.

name: PlaceWise
conflict_findings: .com/.io registered; 'placewise' naming already used (Placewise retail/media); generic 'place' root.

name: NewGround
conflict_findings: .com registered; 'break new ground' is a common idiom and NewGround/newgrounds is an established media brand.
thai_pronunciation_note: nyuu-GROWND; Thai: 'nd/-ground' ending is awkward (no g-final cluster)

name: Suki
conflict_findings: .com/.io registered; common given name and Thai word (สุกี/suki = suki hotpot, also 'like/love' in Thai) - confusing for a Thai launch and many existing brands.
thai_pronunciation_note: SU-kee; in Thai also means 'hotpot'/'fancy' - brand ambiguity

name: Cleo
conflict_findings: .com/.io registered; very popular fintech/AI brand name (Cleo) and common name; social handles saturated; weak mark.

name: Nova
conflict_findings: .io registered; extremely common brand/word ('nova') across many sectors; bare human/star names are unregistrable-feeling and handles gone.

name: Remy
conflict_findings: .com/.io registered; common name (Rémy) and multiple brands; relocation-irrelevant.

name: Indi
conflict_findings: .com registered; reads as 'India/Indi' and a common name; ambiguous geography; handles likely gone.

name: Mara
conflict_findings: .io registered; common name and word across languages (also Thai-ish); weak/confusable.
